newsitem.title: GERMANY: Police scour German town for giant circus snake.
newsitem.headline: Police scour German town for giant circus snake.

text.p: German police were on Wednesday scouring the small town of Gelnhausen for a six-metre (20-foot) Anaconda snake which escaped from a travelling circus.
The South American snake slid out of its box last Sunday and the circus has since moved on, a police spokesman said.

"The public has been warned. We've been searching since Sunday but we obviously cannot devote all our resources to this. It's probably lying motionless somewhere in this cold weather and may even be dead. It's not poisonous."
Anacondas kill their prey by squeezing it to death.
Media reports said the public need not be too alarmed since the snake ate a goat recently and was unlikely to be very hungry.
